caption:
Slow follow-up bleeds revenue you never see.

The free Revenue Calculator takes four inputs: monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and how fast you currently respond.

It hands back your revenue per lead, a modeled follow-up gap for your business, and an annual scenario if you close that gap by 10%. These are illustrative estimates built on your numbers, not guarantees.

Industry data shows most service businesses take over an hour to answer a new lead. Faster response times correlate with higher close rates. Run your own numbers and see where you stand.

Four inputs. Your numbers.

DM TOOLS.
